summary: Describes site profile history entries, tracking actions and associated user data for changes made to site profiles.
purpose: Maintain a log of historical changes made to site profiles, including the user responsible and the nature of changes.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the history entry

fields.name: ActionDate
fields.description: Date when the action was taken

fields.name: ScreenSection
fields.description: Part of the screen where the action took place

fields.name: UserAction
fields.description: Description of the action taken by the user

fields.name: LastName
fields.description: Last name of the user who made changes

fields.name: FirstName
fields.description: First name of the user who made changes

fields.name: MiddleName
fields.description: Middle name of the user who made changes

fields.name: ByUserID
fields.description: User ID of the person who took the action

fields.name: ByOriginalUserID
fields.description: Original user ID if the user has changed

fields.name: ByUserSysAdmin
fields.description: Indicates if the action was taken by a system admin

business_rules.name: User Identification
business_rules.description: Identify users based on ID and admin status for logging purposes
